title: MemoryReflectionsStateResponse
description: Success payload for memory.reflections.state (§7.25). Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.reflections.state (§7.25): No state-read-specific codes are documented beyond NOT_AUTHORIZED.. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.

state_digest.description: 64 lowercase hex over the state described above.

profile_kinds.description: Profile kinds present for the subject.

last_reflection_id.description: Optional most recent reflection id for this selection.

missing_required_profile_kinds.description: Required kinds absent; non-empty fails generation with PROFILE_INCOMPLETE (MEM-R005).

data_sufficiency.description: Engine/provider policy verdict; the protocol defines no numeric thresholds.

error.description: Memory error envelope: shared ErrorEnvelope plus required details.retry_class (§14.1–14.2).
